note: Frames of text_corpus whose text pixels are not all within 2 code values of the capture: the most pixels beyond 2 code values (over2) and the largest difference (max) each may have, as measured 2026-10-18. Each is a gap in docs/engine/text-render.md. A pinned frame may not get worse; a pin whose frame becomes exact fails the test until it is removed. Keys are <project> t=<time>, iso:<project> t=<time> for text in isolation.
